moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The new Premier League season for 2026/27 begins on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal taking on newly promoted Coventry City, marking the start of a packed opening weekend.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off tomorrow! Who are you backing for the title this year? Arsenal vs Coventry City gets us started.

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: After a 25-year absence, Coventry City are back in the Premier League, facing champions Arsenal in their opening fixture! What a return to the top flight!

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Premier League action all weekend! From Hull City vs Man Utd on Saturday to Newcastle vs Liverpool on Sunday, there's no shortage of football. What match are you most excited for?

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Underway
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season is already in full swing, having commenced between August 14th and 17th, with teams battling for promotion.

angles.name: Championship Action
angles.copy: The Championship is back and already delivering! Plenty of action in the opening rounds as teams eye promotion. Who's your pick to go up this season?

angles.name: Welsh Teams in EFL
angles.copy: How are our Welsh teams faring in the Championship? Cardiff City, Swansea City, and Wrexham are all in the thick of it this season. Keep up with their progress!

moments.title: Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix weekend kicks off tomorrow, August 21st, in Zandvoort, Netherlands, featuring a Sprint format and running until August 23rd.

angles.name: F1 Weekend Starts
angles.copy: Lights out for the Dutch Grand Prix weekend! F1 is back in Zandvoort starting tomorrow with Sprint Qualifying. Who's taking pole?

angles.name: Sprint Format Return
angles.copy: The Sprint format makes its return at the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend. More racing, more drama, more points up for grabs!

moments.title: Sam Curran Undergoes Surgery
moments.blurb: England all-rounder Sam Curran is set to undergo groin surgery on Friday, August 21st, ruling him out for the remainder of the home cricket season.

angles.name: Curran Injury Update
angles.copy: Tough news for England cricket fans: Sam Curran is having groin surgery tomorrow, ending his home season. Wishing him a speedy recovery!

angles.name: Impact on England Squad
angles.copy: Sam Curran's surgery is a blow for England's cricket squad. Who do you think will step up in his absence for the rest of the season?
